q: Coral reefs have a very high _____. (2026-Set 1) (2025- Set 13)
e: Coral reefs are among the most diverse ecosystems on Earth, hosting a vast array of marine life.

q: The number of species in a community is known as species _____. (2025- Set 9)
e: Species richness specifically refers to the total count of different species present in a defined area or community.

q: Genetic diversity is the variety of genes within a _____. (2026- နိုင်ငံခြား) (2025- Set 6)
e: Genetic diversity encompasses the wide range of different genetic traits found within the individuals of a single species.

q: All organisms in an ecosystem can affect the _____ conditions around them. (2025- Set 9)
e: Living organisms can alter the physical environment around them, such as plants changing soil chemistry or beavers creating dams.

q: Forest ecosystems are a _____ sink and stabilize soils. (2025- Set 1)
e: Forests act as critical carbon sinks by absorbing atmospheric carbon dioxide through photosynthesis and storing it in biomass.

q: The diverse habitats are home for a wide range of _____. (2025- Set 3)
e: A variety of natural habitats provides the necessary niches and resources to support a high number of different species.

q: Forest ecosystems are a _____ sink and stabilize soils. (2026-Set 1)
e: Trees capture and store massive amounts of carbon, making forest ecosystems essential for regulating the global climate.

q: _____ occurs where rainfall is usually less than 400 mm a year. (2025- Set 8,11)
e: Dry forests develop in arid or semi-arid regions characterized by low annual precipitation, typically receiving less than 400 mm of rain.

q: Rhododendron arboretum is the _____ species in Myanmar. (2025- Set 5)
e: Rhododendron arboretum faces severe threats to its survival in its natural habitat, leading to its classification as an endangered species.

q: The Red Data Book includes the list of endangered species of _____. (2024-Set 2)
e: The IUCN Red Data Book comprehensively catalogs the conservation status of both threatened plant and animal species worldwide.

q: The common nameof Linpai is _____. (2024-Set 4)
e: The Irrawaddy dolphin, locally known as Linpai, is a culturally significant and protected aquatic mammal found in Myanmar's rivers.

q: A variety of human activities threatens the _____ of Myanmar. (2026-Set 2)
e: Human agricultural practices and land-use changes heavily threaten agrobiodiversity, which includes the diverse crop varieties and livestock essential for food systems.

q: Habitats become divided into small areas known as habitat _____. (2025- Set 10)
e: Habitat fragmentation occurs when large, continuous habitats are broken up into smaller, isolated patches due to human activities like road building.

q: Habitat destruction has played a key role in _____. (2025- Set13)
e: The widespread destruction of natural habitats is the leading driver of species extinction across the globe.

q: The destruction of the natural environment leads to _____. (2025- Set 12)
e: When natural environments are cleared or degraded, the direct consequence is the complete loss of the habitats that native species depend on.

q: Habitat loss is the most significant cause of _____ loss globally. (2024-Set 3 / 2025-Set 7)
e: The destruction of natural habitats remains the single largest threat to global biodiversity, pushing countless species toward extinction.

q: Climate change is a growing threat to _____. (2024-နိုင်ငံခြား, ရန်ကုန်နှင့်တိုင်းခရိုင်အချို့တွင်မေး/2025-Set 1)
e: Rapid shifts in temperature and weather patterns disrupt ecosystems, posing a severe and growing threat to overall global biodiversity.

q: Wildlife trade can involve the trade of _____ individuals. (2024-Set 2/2025-Set 5)
e: The illegal wildlife trade involves the trafficking of both live animals for the exotic pet trade and dead animals or their parts for food and medicine.

q: Pangolins are the only _____ mammal on earth. (2025- Set 4,12)
e: Pangolins are uniquely covered in large, protective keratin scales, making them the only truly scaly mammals on Earth.

q: More than one million pangolins were poached and killed for their _____. (2025- Set 11)
e: Pangolins are heavily poached primarily for their scales, which are highly valued in some traditional medicines.

q: Wildlife smuggling directly affects the _____ of different ecosystems. (2025- Set 6)
e: Removing key species through illegal smuggling disrupts local food webs and significantly diminishes the biodiversity of ecosystems.

q: The most trafficked animal in the world is the _____. (2024-ရန်ကုန်နှင့်တိုင်းခရိုင်အချို့တွင်မေး)
e: Due to the immense illegal demand for their scales and meat, pangolins are the most heavily trafficked mammals worldwide.

q: Seeds are kept in cold, dark conditions in a _____. (2025- Set 4)
e: Seed banks are specialized facilities that preserve plant genetic diversity by storing seeds under controlled, cold, and dark conditions.

q: Dried seeds are stored in a temperature of -14°C and in _____ conditions. (2025- Set 7)
e: To maintain long-term seed viability, seed banks store dried seeds at sub-zero temperatures in completely dark environments.

q: Botanical gardens play an important role as valuable sources of plant _____. (2025- Set 2)
e: Botanical gardens maintain living collections that serve as crucial resources for studying plant ecology and environmental interactions.

q: _____ gardens are ideal places to integrate the study and conservation of trees species that are endangered in the wild. (2024-Set 4)
e: Botanical gardens actively cultivate and protect diverse plant species, providing a safe haven for trees that are endangered in their natural habitats.

q: Seed banks protect and save _____. (2024-နောက်ဆက်တွဲမေးခွန်း)
e: By preserving seeds from thousands of different plant species, seed banks safeguard the plant genetic diversity necessary for future agriculture and resilience.

q: _____ is an area set aside by a national government for the preservation of the natural environment. (2025- Set 8)
e: A national park is a legally protected area designated by a government to conserve wildlife, natural landscapes, and ecological integrity.

q: A marine park is a permanent marine _____ for the conservation of species. (2024-Set 3)
e: Marine parks serve as designated underwater reservations where marine life is protected from exploitation and human interference.

q: A wildlife sanctuary is an area where _____ habitats. (2024-နိုင်ငံခြား)
e: Wildlife sanctuaries are specifically established to provide safe refuge and protection for animal species and their natural habitats.

q: Hlawga park is a type of _____. (2026-နိုင်ငံခြား) (2024-နောက်ဆက်တွဲမေးခွန်း)
e: Hlawga National Park functions as a wildlife sanctuary and protected area, established to conserve local fauna and provide environmental education.
